title: Decision Provenance Signal Synthesis for Region/Tier Routing
creator: Asha Menon
description:
Problem: Our current routing telemetry captures per-hop metrics and sparse decision traces, but it is difficult to correlate routing decisions that span region selection, tier routing, and fallback model variants into a concise, queryable signal. Engineers and SREs spend significant time stitching logs, inflating debugging time for P0/P1 incidents and making cost attribution for fallbacks unreliable.

Goal: Produce a synthesized decision provenance signal that compactly encodes the rationale and outcome of routing decisions across hops (region, tier, model-variant) while remaining storage- and query-efficient. The signal should be usable in live debugging (streaming traces), retrospective RCA (trace aggregation), and cost/SLO dashboards.

Scope: Instrument the routing layer to emit a canonical "decision_provenance" record per top-level request. The record will reference per-hop micro-metrics but include a compressed summary: selected_region, selected_tier, fallback_chain (ordered short list of variant ids), reason_codes (e.g., capacity_shortage, latency_sla, model_error), latency_ms_breakdown, token_cost_estimate_bucket, and a 1-2 sentence auto-generated rationale produced from structured tags. We will design a compact wire format and an enrichment pipeline that expands the summary for deep-dive queries on demand.

Out of scope: full fidelity per-token traces and long-term retention of all raw traces (those will be sampled separately). This ticket focuses on synthesis, enrichment hooks, sampling policy, and dashboard integration.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical decision_provenance record is emitted for >=95% of requests in the staging routing mesh with the new flag enabled
Synthesis format documented with schema and example payloads in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RI/Decision+Provenance+Schema
Dashboards show a new 'fallback rate by region/tier' chart and 'median decision synthesis latency' metric
Storage and query cost estimate validated: less than 10% additional storage on top of existing sampled traces for the expected QPS in dedicated clusters
Integration test covering a simulated region outage that triggers tier fallback and two model-variant fallbacks; provenance record must capture the fallback_chain and reason_codes
